pairExamples.parameter / argument: The method declares a parameter, and the caller supplies an argument.
pairExamples.authentication / authorization: Authentication identifies the user, while authorization checks permission to read a document.
pairExamples.entity / DTO: The repository loads an entity, and the controller returns a DTO.
pairExamples.validation / verification of facts: Validation checks the schema; verification of facts checks the claims.
pairExamples.precision / recall: Precision measures relevance among retrieved results, while recall measures how much relevant material was retrieved.
pairExamples.mutable / immutable: A mutable list can change, while an immutable list cannot be modified.
